πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’grief’

πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)

πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’

σευ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic enclitic (= Attic σοῦ): ’your, of you’
στενάχοντα: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’groaning’
στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.

τέο: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., Homeric/Ionic gen. sg. (= Attic τίνος): ’of what?’
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that’ (τήν γε μάχην ’that battle’)

ταχεῖα: ταχύς — swift, fleet; fem. voc. sg., in address: ’swift one’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεὴν: τεός — your, thy (epic = Attic σός); fem. acc. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with χρεώ after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τί … χρεώ ’nor any need’) · τις, τι — neut. acc. sg., agreeing with εἶδος after οὔτε: ’any’ (οὔτέ τι εἶδος ’nor any looks’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κακόν after δή: ’some (evil)’ (δή τι κακόν ’some evil’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ); gen. of the person heard after ἀκούω: ’him’ · also temporal: ἐκ τοῖο ’from that time, after that’ · also masc. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that (old man)’ · also plain possessive gen.: ’his’ · also masc. gen. sg. after ἀπό, of separation: ’from him’ (ἀπὸ τοῖο ’from him’) · also masc. gen. sg., governed by ἄνευθεν: ’apart from him’ (τοῖο δ’ ἄνευθεν) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation after ἀπέχω: ’from him’
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’such a one’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’such (a thing)’, alone or correlative with οἷον (τοῖον … οἷον ’such … as’)
τοῖος: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. nom. sg. (τοῖος ... οἷον ’such as’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with them’ (ἅμα τοῖσι ’along with them’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’ · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from it’ · also masc. gen. sg. in a genitive absolute, of a stream: ’it’ (τοῦ … προρέοντος ’as it flows forward’) · also masc. gen. sg. of cause: ’on his account’ (τοῦ δὴ νῦν … φέρεις χάριν ’it is on his account that you bring favour’) · also masc. gen. sg., in a gen. absolute with ἑλκομένοιο: ’as he was dragged’ (τοῦ δ’ ἦν ἑλκομένοιο κονίσαλος) · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, after ἑκάτερθεν: ’of it’ (τοῦ ἑκάτερθεν ’on either side of it’)
τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’even a little’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a pronoun object: ’small, little’ (τυτθὸν ἐόντα ’being small’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μ’ (a girl): ’small’ (τυτθὸν ἐοῦσαν ’while I was small’)
τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τόδ’ αἰνὸν ἄχος ’this dread grief’)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’) · also fem. acc. sg. standing for a feminine thing: ’it’, in the correlative τὴν μέν … ’it, on the one hand’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a participle: ’the (man) who’ (τὸν προὔχοντα ’the one ahead’) · also masc. acc. sg., article-like with an adjective and noun: ’the’ (τὸν δεξιὸν ἵππον ’the right-hand horse’) · also τὸν ἑόν, ’his own’ (τὸν ἑόν … Πόδαργον ’his own Podargus’)
τῇδ: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative adj., fem. dat. sg. τῇδε, elided (τῇδ’): ’with this’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
υἱέϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἱέϊ (= Attic υἱεῖ)
υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., of wish: ’may she carry’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg., in a remote condition after εἰ: ’were to bring’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’might bring’ (ἵν’ … φέροι ’so that she might bring’) · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in an indefinite relative clause (ὅς τις … φέροι): ’whoever might carry’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. with κε, potential in a past unfulfilled condition: ’would have carried off’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, friendly; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’friends!’ · also masc. nom. pl., predicate: ’dear, welcome’ (μῦθοι φίλοι) · also masc. nom. pl., attributive: ’dear’ (φίλοι ἄνδρες ’dear men’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φερέμεν: φέρω — bear, carry, bring; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic φέρειν)
φιλότητα: φιλότης — friendship, love, kindness; fem. acc. sg.
φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; also sexual love; fem. dat. sg.: ἐν φιλότητι ’in love’
φρεσί: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φρονέουσα: φρονέω — think, be minded; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦσα)
φωνήσασα: φωνέω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having spoken’
φώνησέν: φωνέω — speak, utter; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, accented before the enclitic τε
χερὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. sg., epic χερί (= χειρί)
χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν), agreeing with δέπας · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θρόνον: ’golden (throne)’
ψυχὰς: ψυχή — life, spirit, soul; fem. acc. pl.
ἀΐξασα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
ἀγαθὰ: ἀγαθός — good; neut. acc. pl., internal accusative with φρονέοντα: ’good things’ · also neut. acc. pl., after εἰς: ’for good (ends)’
ἀγαθὸν: ἀγαθός — good; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(not) good’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a named man: ’good’ (πὺξ ἀγαθὸν Πολυδεύκεα ’Polydeuces, good with his fists’) · also masc. acc. sg. as a noun: ’a good man’
ἀγγελέουσα: ἀγγέλλω — bring news, announce; fut. part. act. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀγγελοῦσα), of purpose: ’to bring news’
ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, address an assembly; impf. 3 pl.
ἀγύρει: ἄγυρις — gathering, throng; fem. dat. sg.: ’in a throng (of the dead)’
ἀελλόπος: ἀελλόπος — storm-footed, swift as a gale (ἄελλα + πούς); fem. nom. sg., epithet of Iris
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’) · also gen. pl. as a noun, predicate possessive: ’of the immortals’ (ἔργ’ ἔμεν ἀθανάτων ’to be works of the immortals’)
ἀκτὴν: ἀκτή — grain, ground corn (Δημήτερος ἀκτή ’Demeter’s grain’); fem. acc. sg. · also ἀκτή — headland, shore; fem. acc. sg., goal of motion: ’onto the shore’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’) · also adv. and preverb in tmesis, elided: ’round about’ (ἀμφ’ … ἀΰτευν ’rang round about’) · also + gen., ’about, over’ (ἀμφ’ ὀλίγης πίδακος ’about a small spring’)

ἀνδρός: ἀνήρ — man, husband; masc. gen. sg.
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’) · also + acc. of place: ’up on’ (ἀνὰ μυρίκην ’up on a tamarisk’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ θυμόν: ’in the heart, in the mind’ · also + acc. of extent: ’along’ (ἀνὰ δρόμον ’along the course’)
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
ἀπίθησε: ἀπιθέω — disobey (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, negated by οὐδέ: ’did not disobey’
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπό: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., also adverbial in tmesis with a verb (ἀπό … ὄλωλεν); accented before an enclitic (ἀπό τέ σφισιν)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀργεϊφόντην: Ἀργεϊφόντης — Argeïphontes, epithet of Hermes, traditionally ’slayer of Argus’ though the sense is disputed; masc. acc. sg.
ἀργεϊφόντης: Ἀργεϊφόντης — ’Argeïphontes’, standing epithet of Hermes, conventionally ’slayer of Argus’; masc. nom. sg.; the meaning is disputed, not actually known
ἀργυρόπεζα: ἀργυρόπεζα — silver-footed, epithet of Thetis; fem. nom. sg.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω: ’grieving’
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic -εῖ)
ἀχιλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. gen. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλέως)
ἀχιλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. dat. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῖ)
ἁδινὰ: ἁδινός — thick, close-packed, heavy; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’heavily, in close succession’
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγοι: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a potential clause: ’would lead’
ἄγοιτο: ἄγω — lead; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a wish: ’may he lead (home)’ · also potential with κεν: ’would bring’ (μῦθον … διὰ στόμα ἄγοιτο ’would bring a word through his mouth’)
ἄγχ: ἄγχι — near, close by; adv./prep. + gen., elided (ἄγχ’ = ἄγχι): ’near Ajax’
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄλοχον: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
ἄμαξαν: ἄμαξα — wagon, cart; fem. acc. sg.
ἄνευθεν: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart, aside, at a distance; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’away from’ (ἄνευθεν … πατρός τε φίλων τε ’away from my father and my dear ones’)
ἄνωγε: ἄνωγα — command, bid, order; perf. with pres./past force, 3 sg.: ’bids, bade’
ἄποινα: ἄποινα — ransom (a neuter plural noun); nom./acc. pl.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, masc. acc. sg.: ’best’ · also neut. acc. sg.: ’the best (thing)’ (μέγ’ ἄριστον ’by far the best’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’the best (thing)’ (ὃ … ἄριστον … εἴη ’that would be the best’)
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄφρων: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. nom. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
ἐΰσκοπον: ἐΰσκοπος — keen-sighted, sharp-eyed; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀργεϊφόντην: ’keen-sighted’
ἐΰτροχον: ἐΰτροχος — well-rolling, with good wheels (Attic εὔτροχος); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἅρμα
ἐκέλευσεν: κελεύω — command, order, bid; aor. 3 sg.: ’ordered’
ἐκαλέσσατο: καλέω — call, summon; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic doubled σσ (= Attic ἐκαλέσατο): ’called to himself’
ἐλεαίρει: ἐλεαίρω — pity, feel compassion for (epic by-form of ἐλεέω); pres. 3 sg.
ἐλθὲ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
ἐμέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., accented emphatic form (non-enclitic) (= enclitic με): ’me’
ἐμέθεν: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμέθεν (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’of me’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than I’ (κρείσσων … ἐμέθεν ’stronger than I’)
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
ἐνοπήν: ἐνοπή — voice, cry, sound; fem. acc. sg.
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’) · also + dat. of aim: ’for, with a view to’ (ἐπ’ ἀρωγῇ ’for help’) · also + dat. of cause: ’at’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ γέλασσαν ’laughed at him’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν; Attic ἐπάν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a temporal clause: ’when’ (ἐπὴν τεισαίμεθα ’when we have avenged’)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐρύξει: ἐρύκω — hold back, check, restrain; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will check’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐσθλοὶ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; adj., masc. nom. pl.
ἐσσυμένως: ἐσσυμένως — hastily, eagerly; adv. from the participle of σεύομαι ’rush’
ἐστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἐστ’ = ἐστί)
ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’companions!’ (ἐρίηρες ἑταῖροι ’trusty companions’)

ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔκτανε: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., strong aorist ἔκτανον: ’killed’
ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
ἔνδοθεν: ἔνδοθεν — from within, within; adv. (+ gen.), -θεν suffix
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔξοχα: ἔξοχος — outstanding, preeminent; neut. pl. used as adv.: ’above all, outstandingly’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπλετο: πέλομαι — be, become; aor. 3 sg. mid., no augment, with pres. force or gnomic in a simile: ’comes to be, is’ · also ordinary past: ’came to be’
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἔχουσα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕδος: ἕδος — seat, abode; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address · also masc. acc. sg., epic elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορα), object of σχήσουσι: ’Hector’ (πελώριον Ἕκτορ’ ’huge Hector’) · also masc. dat. sg., elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορι), after ἅμα: ’with Hector’ (ἅμ’ Ἕκτορ’ ἴσαν ’went with Hector’)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’) · also in tmesis (διὰ … ἕλε = διεῖλε): ’tore through’ (διὰ δ’ ἀμφοτέρους ἕλε κύκλους ’tore through both rings’)
ἕποιτο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid. dep., potential with κε: ’would follow’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it followed’ · also in a condition after εἰ, of a wished-for case: ’if he would follow’ (εἴ τίς μοι … ἕποιτο)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠνώγει: ἄνωγα (old perf. with pres. force) — bid, command; plpf. 3 sg. with past force, augmented (beside ἀνώγει), + inf.: ’bade’
ἡγεῖτ: ἡγέομαι — lead, lead the way; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided ἡγεῖτ’ (= ἡγεῖτο): ’led the way’
ἡμιόνους: ἡμίονος — mule; masc. acc. pl.; accent from the enclitic τε
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’ · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative for a thing: ’it’ (of a spear)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤλυθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., epic ἤλυθες (= Attic ἦλθες): ’you came’
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἰέναι: εἶμι — go; pres. inf.: ’to go’ · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’go, return’ (ἐλάσας ἰέναι πάλιν ’having driven them off, go back’)
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰόντ: εἶμι — go; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἰόντ’ = ἰόντα): ’going’
ἱκάνω: ἱκάνω (poetic by-form of ἱκνέομαι) — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 1 sg.
ἱρήν: ἱρός — holy, sacred; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic ἱρός (= Attic ἱερός)
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him go, let him come’
ἶρι: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. voc. sg.
ἶριν: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. acc. sg. · also ἶρις — rainbow; fem. acc. sg. (πορφυρέην ἶριν ’a purple rainbow’)
ἶρις: Ἶρις — Iris, messenger of the gods; fem. nom. sg.
ἷξεν: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. 3 sg. ἷξε(ν), movable ν
ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
ὀλέσαντες: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having lost’
ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
ὁμηγερέες: ὁμηγερής — gathered together, assembled; masc. nom. pl.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄρωρεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; perf. 3 sg. with ν-movable: ’has arisen’
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’urge on!’
ὄϊς: ὄϊς — sheep; common gender (masc. or fem.), acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς): ’sheep’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of perceiving: ’that’ (οὐδ’ ἐνόησεν ὅ … ’did not perceive that …’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + fut. indic.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … οἴσεται ’whoever will carry off’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + opt.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … πέλοιτο ’whoever should prove’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’) · also + gen. of the cause, ’before, at the onslaught of’ (ὑπ’ Ἀχιλλῆος ’before Achilles’) · also + a φιν-form: ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὄχεσφιν ’under the chariots’)
ὑψόροφον: ὑψόροφος — high-roofed; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg.
ὠκέα: ὠκύς — swift; fem. nom. sg., epic -έα (= -εῖα), epithet of Iris
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤρεξε: ὀρέγω — stretch out, hold out, grant; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’granted’
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’ · also of a sound, aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’arose’
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
